title: tetra-condition
description: De-densify + smooth a tetra mesh: quadric decimation -> Taubin smoothing (volume-preserving) -> nearest-vertex color transfer from source -> cleanup. 006: 32.2M->1.0M tris, 1184MB->33MB.

target_tris.description: effective max = source tri count (per-mesh, not universal); 1M validated as deliverable scale; bounds unmeasured (T-002) — extend with evidence, don't invent

taubin_iters.description: 0 disables smoothing; 10 validated; upper bounds unmeasured (T-002) — extend with evidence, don't invent
